---
title: "Guaranteed to Fail"
date: "2011-05-18"
categories: ["Economics", "Financial Markets"]
---

My review of [Guaranteed to Fail](http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/0691150788?ie=UTF8&tag=institutional-20&linkCode=xm2&camp=1789&creativeASIN=0691150788) is available at [The Conversation](http://theconversation.edu.au/articles/freddie-mac-and-fannie-mae-guaranteed-to-fail-1856). Oddly enough, the book also gets an endorsement on its jacket from our old enemy Nouriel Roubini. Since the authors are colleagues of Roubini at Stern, this may just be a collegial courtesy. Roubini’s endorsement is ironic because the book demonstrates that the crisis looked nothing like any of Nouriel’s many and varied pre-crisis narratives. Nouriel managed to forecast every crisis except the one that actually occurred.
